versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Shelly Brand Name Generator skill.
- Generates 20 creative brand name ideas for any specified industry.
- Names include clear style (invented, compound, metaphor, etc.), vibe, and .com domain availability hint.
- Supports optional brand attributes and specific naming styles.
- Outputs 3 wildcard bonus names for extra creative inspiration.
- Ensures names are easy to pronounce, spell, and remember.
